failures.cause: GCEZone._now() in libcloud/compute/drivers/gce.py was changed from datetime.utcnow() to datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc), which returns a timezone-aware datetime while the test and prior behavior require a naive UTC value (now.tzinfo must be None).
failures.fix: Keep using datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc) but return naive UTC from _now() with .replace(tzinfo=None), and remove the next_begin tzinfo normalization in _get_time_until_mw so maintenance-window subtraction stays naive-on-naive as before.
